kit_page.name: operator_kit
kit_page.summary: Handheld operator: how the camera is held and how much it sways, shakes and drifts. Start from a Look, then adjust.

kit_row.help: Curated one-click looks. Applying one changes the controls below; your saved rigs stay separate.
kit_row.label: Look

kit_row.help: The physical rig: tripod, subtle handheld, documentary, shoulder, gimbal and so on. Separate from how the camera moves.
kit_row.keywords: rig style tripod handheld shoulder gimbal documentary verite
kit_row.label: Rig

kit_row.help: What the operator is physically doing: creep, walk, run, drive or float. Auto follows camera speed.
kit_row.keywords: locomotion movement walk run creep drive float auto
kit_row.label: Movement

kit_row.help: Performance feel used by Legacy motion. Other movement modes supply their own feel.
kit_row.keywords: feel profile natural locked follow restless composed drift snap march
kit_row.label: Feel

kit_row.help: Applies this operator rig to the live joystick flycam.
kit_row.label: Live flycam

kit_row.help: Keeps the walking gait at full strength even when the camera is still.
kit_row.label: Force gait

kit_row.help: Seconds to crossfade when you change Movement mid-shot. 0 is an instant change.
kit_row.label: Blend (s)

kit_row.help: Fixed update rate for the newer Movement modes. Legacy keeps its original timing.
kit_row.label: Update Hz

kit_row.help: Overall strength of all handheld motion, from 0 to 2. 1 is normal.
kit_row.label: Master

kit_row.help: How much forward and back travel shows. 0 removes it; above 1 exaggerates it.
kit_row.label: Forward/back

kit_row.help: How much side-to-side body and footfall movement shows. 0 removes it; 1 is normal.
kit_row.label: Left/right

kit_row.help: How much step bob, breathing lift and suspension bounce show. 0 removes it; 1 is normal.
kit_row.keywords: heave up down bob lift gain
kit_row.label: Up/down

kit_row.help: How much rotation about the lens axis shows, from shoulder lean and heel strikes. 0 removes it.
kit_row.keywords: roll horizon tilt dutch lean gain
kit_row.label: Horizon tilt

kit_row.help: How much vertical aim wander and reactive tilt shows. 0 removes it; 1 is normal.
kit_row.keywords: pitch look up down tilt gain
kit_row.label: Look up/down

kit_row.help: How much horizontal aim wander and reactive pan shows. 0 removes it; 1 is normal.
kit_row.keywords: yaw pan left right look gain
kit_row.label: Pan left/right

kit_row.help: How much the lens breathes in and out. 0 holds the lens steady without collapsing the field of view.
kit_row.label: Lens breathing

kit_row.help: How slowly the camera follows its resolved pose. 0 is rigid; higher values glide.
kit_row.label: Glide

kit_row.help: Strength of the camera's response to motion. Idle movement is not affected.
kit_row.label: Reactivity

kit_row.help: Seconds the operator waits before reacting and reframing after the camera moves. 0 reacts at once.
kit_row.label: Reaction lag

kit_row.help: Vertical frame offset is set on Frame & Orbit > Auto reframe (-20..20).
kit_row.label: Frame offset up

kit_row.help: How hard camera movement drives the pan axis.
kit_row.label: Motion pan

kit_row.help: How hard camera movement drives the tilt axis.
kit_row.label: Motion tilt

kit_row.help: How hard camera movement drives the roll axis.
kit_row.label: Motion roll

kit_row.help: How much reactive motion calms the idle tremor.
kit_row.label: Motion calm

kit_row.help: How strongly the Legacy feel modifies the rig, from 0 to 1.
kit_row.label: Profile mix

kit_row.help: How much motion response feeds into tremor.
kit_row.label: Energy

kit_row.help: Overshoot bounce when the camera stops moving. 0 turns it off.
kit_row.label: Settle

kit_row.help: Speed of the stop bounce, in cycles per second.
kit_row.label: Bounce Hz

kit_row.help: Inertia whip when motion starts. Higher gives a sharper start.
kit_row.label: Onset

kit_row.help: How quickly the settle bounce dies away each frame. Higher rings longer.
kit_row.label: Settle decay

kit_row.help: Size in degrees of the occasional sparse reframing nudge. 0 is off.
kit_row.label: Recompose

kit_row.help: Average seconds between reframing nudges.
kit_row.label: Recomp sec

kit_row.help: Lead and lag during pans. Negative values flip the direction.
kit_row.label: Drag

kit_row.help: Hand stability: 0 is jittery, 1 is smooth and heavy.
kit_row.keywords: steady stability tremor hand damping jitter
kit_row.label: Steady

kit_row.help: How much the camera drifts on its own when still. 1 is normal.
kit_row.label: Idle wander

kit_row.help: Speed of the procedural motion. 1 is normal.
kit_row.label: Time speed

kit_row.help: Scales how responsive the motion smoothing is. 1 is normal.
kit_row.label: Smoothing

kit_row.help: Random seed for the procedural motion pattern. Change it for a different wander with the same settings.
kit_row.label: Seed

kit_row.help: Character of the sideways wander: smooth noise, a sine weave, or raw noise.
kit_row.keywords: pan style wander weave noise fbm
kit_row.label: Pan style

kit_row.help: How far the camera idly wanders sideways, in degrees.
kit_row.label: Pan amount

kit_row.help: Smooths out fast sideways jitter. Higher is calmer.
kit_row.label: Pan smooth

kit_row.help: Extra sideways smoothing that applies only while the camera is actually panning.
kit_row.label: Pan react

kit_row.help: How fast the idle pan and tilt wander, in cycles per second.
kit_row.label: Pan/tilt Hz

kit_row.help: How far the camera idly wanders up and down, in degrees.
kit_row.label: Tilt amount

kit_row.help: How far the horizon idly wanders, in degrees.
kit_row.label: Roll amount

kit_row.help: Horizon roll on each footstep, in degrees.
kit_row.label: Step roll

kit_row.help: How fast the idle roll wanders, in cycles per second.
kit_row.label: Roll Hz

kit_row.help: Strips high-frequency jitter from the roll only.
kit_row.label: Roll damp

kit_row.help: How much the frame pulses in and out, in percent.
kit_row.keywords: breath breathing amount percent fov pulse
kit_row.label: Breath %

kit_row.help: How fast the breathing pulse runs, in cycles per second.
kit_row.label: Breath Hz

kit_row.help: Vertical rise coupled to each breath. 0 is none.
kit_row.label: Breath lift

kit_row.help: How much camera movement strengthens the breathing pulse.
kit_row.label: Motion breath

kit_row.help: Walking step rate. 1 is about 120 beats per minute.
kit_row.keywords: cadence walk gait step rate tempo
kit_row.label: Cadence

kit_row.help: Vertical head bounce per step, in meters.
kit_row.label: Step bounce

kit_row.help: How strongly motion drives the walking gait.
kit_row.label: Gait strength

kit_row.help: Side-to-side head shift per stride, in meters.
kit_row.label: Step sway

kit_row.help: How much forward and back motion induces the gait.
kit_row.label: Forward gait

kit_row.help: How much sideways panning induces the gait. Keep it low.
kit_row.label: Lateral gait

kit_row.help: How much moving faster raises the step rate.
kit_row.label: Speed drive

kit_row.help: Linear speed above which Creep becomes Walk in Auto movement. Angular speed never counts.
kit_row.keywords: auto walk enter threshold speed creep
kit_row.label: Walk above

kit_row.help: Linear speed above which Walk becomes Run in Auto movement.
kit_row.keywords: auto run enter threshold speed walk
kit_row.label: Run above

kit_row.help: Speed below which Walk drops back to Creep. Keep it under Walk above so it does not flicker.
kit_row.keywords: auto walk exit threshold hysteresis creep
kit_row.label: Walk below

kit_row.help: Speed below which Run drops back to Walk.
kit_row.label: Run below

kit_row.help: Linear speed in m/s that counts as a normal move. The Auto thresholds scale from it.
kit_row.label: Ref linear

kit_row.help: Angular speed in degrees per second that counts as a normal pan.
kit_row.label: Ref angular

kit_row.help: Seconds the speed must stay above Walk above before Creep becomes Walk.
kit_row.keywords: auto walk enter dwell time seconds
kit_row.label: Walk in sec

kit_row.help: Seconds the speed must stay below Walk below before Walk becomes Creep.
kit_row.keywords: auto walk exit dwell time seconds
kit_row.label: Walk out sec

kit_row.help: Seconds the speed must stay above Run above before Walk becomes Run.
kit_row.keywords: auto run enter dwell time seconds
kit_row.label: Run in sec

kit_row.help: Seconds the speed must stay below Run below before Run becomes Walk.
kit_row.keywords: auto run exit dwell time seconds
kit_row.label: Run out sec
